display.summary: Incremental system backups (chains of a full backup plus changes-only increments, restorable to any point, readable in the DLB viewer) and per-user General Reports for report viewers, on top of 1.11.0b3.
highlights: Incremental backups store only changed and deleted rows and new media since the previous backup.
Restore any point of a chain in one step; a missing or foreign member is refused before anything changes.
Scheduled backups can run incrementally, with a new full backup by age or chain length.
The DLB viewer opens a backup chain as its merged state and groups models by app.
General Reports: staff with the reports permission can open each listed user's activity breakdown.
Database migration: additive and inline-safe (backup chain columns).
